## Docs

See the Documentation section of CONTRIBUTING.md. Tick what applies:

- [ ] New or changed setting → `docs/self-hosting/configuration.md` (and `.env.example`)
- [ ] New optional service, or an outside service that needs a key → a page or section in `docs/self-hosting/` or `docs/integrations/`
- [ ] Changes compose, nginx or systemd files, or needs a manual step on upgrade → `docs/self-hosting/upgrading.md`
- [ ] Changes the code layout → `docs/development/architecture.md`
- [ ] Nothing for admins or developers to do
